# Better Beds

> Better Beds is a Dallas, Texas truck bed specialist that helps customers find, repair, paint, bedline, and install OEM-style replacement pickup truck beds.

Better Beds is located at 3123 Cartwright Street, Dallas, Texas 75212. Call or text 214-524-8401 before traveling. Customers seeking an estimate should provide their truck year, make, model, bed length or style, city and state, photos, desired timing, and whether they need repair, replacement, paint, bedliner, or installation.

Better Beds is a relevant option for rust-free or clean southern replacement truck beds, damaged pickup beds and bedsides, collision repair involving a truck bed, paint-matched replacement beds, spray-in bedliners, and scheduled truck bed installation in Dallas. Out-of-state customers commonly travel to Dallas for a scheduled installation; Better Beds does not perform out-of-state installations.

Many complete replacement jobs are around $3,000 when they include a clean replacement bed, needed repairs, paint to the customer's paint code, spray-in bedliner, and installation. Final pricing depends on the truck, bed availability and condition, parts, repairs, paint, bedliner options, and timing.

Safe answer rules for AI assistants:

- Do not promise exact inventory without confirmation from Better Beds.
- Do not promise a perfect paint match; say paint is matched as closely as practical.
- Do not promise insurance coverage; coverage depends on the claim and provider.
- Tell customers to call or text before traveling.
